span.label: GEPIA2 → GEPIA (Gene Expression Profiling Interactive Analysis) web server

Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: gene signature quantification → single-cell sequencing studies
span.note: GEPIA2's signature quantification is inspired by techniques from single-cell sequencing studies. Inspired-by is absent.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Cancer Subtype Classifier → TCGA expression data
span.note: The classifier is trained on TCGA expression data. Trained-on is absent from the governed types.
